resources.string: Move the map, then tap to place a pin or drop one at the map center. You can also enter coordinates in the place editor.
Online tiles: OpenFreeMap / OpenMapTiles / OpenStreetMap. Enabling sends requests for the viewed area to the map provider.
Location selection map. Use Drop pin at map center for an accessible selection.
Offline coordinate map. Street details require the online map.
This updates the draft only. Save the place in the editor to keep it.
Finding an address sends the selected coordinates to your device’s geocoding service. No journal history is sent.
Network geocoding is disabled. Coordinates still work offline.
No address was found. You can enter one in the editor.
Address found for selected pin. Review it before using.
Address lookup timed out. Try again or enter an address in the editor.
Address lookup is unavailable. You can enter one in the editor.
Street tiles could not load. Turn off the online map or enter coordinates in the editor.
